text_block_list.text: The "Osaka Hai"—many experienced Umamusume enter, making it a high-level contest. However, the one drawing the most attention toward Duramente is—
choice_data_list: Kitasan Black looked like she was in great form.
Kitasan Black looked like she was in great form.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...

Duramente, who always chooses her races logically and precisely,
chose this race with Kitasan Black firmly in mind.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: “—Shouldering it all, I want to become the best in the world!”

What is needed to bear the weight of everything...
That is likely to be found in today's race.
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll grasp something today.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I—feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan's Fans
text_block_list.text: Kitasaaan Blaaack~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...!
Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I fell in love with you at the Kikuka Sho!
Win it with sheer grit!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We entrust our hopes to you!
Leave it to us! Ki-ta-san! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I love seeing you run with everything you've got!
Go for it~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, thank you so much 
for all your loud cheers!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll run with everything I've got!
It might look clumsy, but... please watch me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, HEAVE-HO!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan's Fans
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dura-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "I'm so happy we get to fight side by side... so soon!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I watched the Nakayama Kinen!
Dura-san, you really are so strong."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Throughout my Classic year,
I feel like I was always chasing after her back.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now, Dura-san.
I think... you're the one who was chasing me."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
At the Kikuka Sho,
I was able to change.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I... knew it, I really don't want to lose to Dura-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
With how I am now, I can do it!
I'll definitely pull off a front-running victory!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Me too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"To you, of all people...
I simply cannot lose."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why it had to be you.
But... surely, today will give us the answer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Kitasan Black.
Let's settle this.
